Nervous aphonia with cardiac de-
rangement. [Coca; Hydrocy, ac.] Burning sensation
from throat down. Breathing spasmodic, with con-

depriving of breath. Prsecordial pains which dart to
the left shoulder. Aortic insj^fficiency.

At 6 A.M. was suddenly seized with a distressing feeling in the whole ab¬
